section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: Inspection of power source circuit.
ocr_text:
A    Inspection of power source circuit.

Turn ignition switch on.

Is ECU-IG fuse normal?
Is operation normal?

No → Replace fuse. → No → • Short circuit in wire harness between ECU-IG fuse and terminal 2 of main relay.
• Inspect main relay.
(See page BE-81, 82)

Yes ↓

Yes ↓
Fuse faulty.

MAIN RELAY

INSPECT GROUND CONNECTION
Is there continuity between terminal 3 and body ground, and between terminal 1 and body ground?

No → • Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 3 or 1 of main relay and body ground.
• Body ground faulty.

Yes ↓

INSPECT POWER SOURCE
Is there battery voltage between terminal 2 and body ground?

No → Open circuit in wire harness between ECU-IG fuse and terminal 2 of main relay.

Yes ↓

INSPECT RELAY OPERATION
Is there battery voltage between terminal 6 and body ground with terminal 4 grounded?

No → Inspect main relay.
(See page BE-81, 82)

Yes ↓

Is there battery voltage between terminal 6 and body ground?

Yes → Inspect main relay.
(See page BE-81, 82)

No ↓

MAIN SWITCH

INSPECT GROUND CONNECTION
Is there continuity between terminal *3 or **2 and body ground?

No → • Open circuit in wire harness between terminal *3 or **2 of main switch and body ground.
• Body ground faulty.

*: U.S.A. (w/ Airbag system)
**: CANADA (w/o Airbag system)

Yes ↓
